name: Verdurous-Lament
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are binary sunset (multiple suns), breaking the swell in a ragged arc.
Dense air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to starship crash site (warship) are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
Relatives of the lost still charter quiet ships to fly the debris fan. Sometimes they hire escorts. Sometimes they need them.
